figurative_meaning_en: Repayment of debts and receipt of dues
example_sentences_in_bangla: আমাদের মধ্যে হিসাবনিকাশ হয়ে গেছে, আর কোনো দেনা-পাওনা নেই।
ব্যবসায়ের শেষে সব হিসাবনিকাশ করে নাও।
example_sentences_in_english: Our accounts have been settled; there's no debt between us anymore.
At the end of the business deal, make sure to settle all accounts.
note: This idiom reflects traditional Bengali practices of maintaining ledgers in trade and daily transactions.
